canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Belan Iverel: 29-year-old woman, 152 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-4-medium. Face: round full face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; prominent bridge, compact mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a string-bound recipe leaf only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
